In accordance with article 7 of this regulation, a cheque defaulter shall not be allowed to:
- Access any credit facility in banks, microfinance institution or in any lending institution;
- Be provided a new cheque book by any bank or micro finance institution;
- Open a new account in a bank or in a microfinance institution.
The sanctions stipulated here above shall apply for a period of six (6) months for the first incident and one
year for subsequent incidents.

his banks or micro finance institutions.
